findings.message: Sections 7.1 (rung 4) and 7.2 make the merge stage the single writer to main and require it to re-run the hard gate set itself. DEFAULT_GATE_SEVERITY marks bug_evidence hard at merge. Merge re-gating has two paths: chupa/merge.py:346-352 runs CHECK_GATES, and chupa/mergequeue.py:271-274 runs the same tuple during integration. Neither reads Check's checks.json reports; SeedSafetyGate reads only its seeds. The unit names Check as the only executor and writer of the bug_evidence report and gives the merge-time re-run no owner. If the gate joins CHECK_GATES, merge does re-run it, but the exact gate-code list asserted by tests/test_mergequeue.py::test_strategy_resolution_still_regates changes, and that file is outside the fence. If the gate is added only inside check(), a kind: bug branch merges without bug_evidence ever being re-gated. Neither choice is buildable from the spec as it stands.
findings.paved_road: Harden 19.P6.bug-gate-grammar through section 11.4. State whether merge admission re-gates bug_evidence, either by re-executing the regression in gather_evidence for stage merge/merge-integration or by having a merge gate read Check's committed bug_evidence report. Name the owner (chupa/merge.py and/or chupa/mergequeue.py), the tests that pin the merge gate sequence for bug and non-bug tickets, and the files the fence needs. Otherwise, state explicitly that merge's hard set omits bug_evidence and why that agrees with section 7. Then regenerate the seed so its fence and criteria match.
